title: FizzBuzz list
q: Return a list for 1..n: "FizzBuzz" for multiples of 15, "Fizz" for 3, "Buzz" for 5, otherwise the number as a string.

title: Count vowels
q: Return how many vowels (a, e, i, o, u, any case) are in text.
ref:
def count_vowels(text):
    return sum(1 for c in text.lower() if c in "aeiou")

title: Word frequencies
q: Return a dict mapping each lower-cased word of text to how many times it appears. Words are separated by spaces.

title: Flatten a nested list
q: Flatten lists nested to any depth into one flat list, keeping order.

title: Fibonacci with memoization
q: Return the n-th Fibonacci number (fib(0)=0, fib(1)=1). It must stay fast for n = 80.
hints: Remember answers you already computed. A dict works.

title: Squares of the evens
q: In ONE list comprehension, return the squares of the even numbers in nums.
ref:
def even_squares(nums):
    return [n * n for n in nums if n % 2 == 0]

title: Invert a dictionary
q: Swap keys and values of d. If a value repeats, collect its keys in a list. Return {value: [keys...]}.

title: First n primes (generator style)
q: Return a list of the first n prime numbers. (Challenge: write it with a generator function using yield, then call list() on it.)

title: Count calls with a decorator
q: Write counted_calls(n): it defines a function add(a, b) wrapped by a decorator that counts calls, calls add n times with (i, i), and returns a pair [sum of results, number of calls counted].

title: A bank account class
q: Write run_account(ops) with a BankAccount class inside it (balance starts at 0). Ops are ["deposit", x] or ["withdraw", x]. A withdraw bigger than the balance is ignored. Return the final balance.

title: Safe division with exceptions
q: Return a / b. If b is zero return the string "error". If either is not a number return "bad input".

title: Sort people by age then name
q: people is a list of [name, age]. Return it sorted by age (youngest first); ties by name A-Z.
ref:
def sort_people(people):
    return sorted(people, key=lambda p: (p[1], p[0]))

title: Caesar cipher
q: Shift each letter of text forward by k places (wrapping z to a), keeping case. Leave other characters alone.

title: Matrix multiplication
q: Multiply matrix a (m x n) by matrix b (n x p) without libraries and return the m x p result.

title: Sort words by length then alphabet
q: Return words sorted by length (shortest first), ties alphabetical.
ref:
def sort_words(words):
    return sorted(words, key=lambda w: (len(w), w))
